node.statement: Now fix arbitrary U,V in calU. Guard arithmetic gives s:=e+delta<=1/2, t>4e>=0, delta<=1/2, and e<1/6: indeed C_pol*s<=kappa_pol<=1/2 with C_pol>=1 gives s<=1/2, while the second guard gives 4e<t; also t=delta-C_pol*delta*s<=delta*(1-s)=(s-e)*(1-s), whose maximum for e<=s<=1/2 is (1/2-e)/2, so e<t<=(1/2-e)/2 implies e<1/6.
